feedback.end: Pollution is when harmful materials are released into the environment, such as chemicals, gases or waste.

instruction.text: Match the images to the labels to learn about the different types of pollution.

feedback.end: Most air pollution is caused by factories and power plants burning fossil fuels, which release toxic chemicals into the atmosphere.
Water pollution can include rubbish dumped in rivers and oceans, as well as chemical waste from factories and oil spills.
The most common type of land pollution is when household rubbish such as single use plastics are dumped in large areas called landfills.

instruction.text: Let’s take a look at a case study about air pollution management. Select New Delhi on the map to learn more.

feedback.finish: New Delhi is located in the north of India, and is the country’s capital. It is one of the most polluted cities in the world.

instruction.text: Why is air pollution in New Delhi so severe? Read the text and select the matching image.

atoms.a: With more than 8 million cars on the city’s roads, over 2/3 of the air pollution in New Delhi comes from traffic congestion.
atoms.sound: With more than 8 million cars on the city’s roads, over two thirds of the air pollution in New Delhi comes from traffic congestion.

atoms.a: Due to the amount of coal-burning factories and power plants, New Delhi produces a very high amount of greenhouse gas emissions.
New Delhi has a large, and still growing, population of over 34 million people.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: To combat the high levels of air pollution in New Delhi, the local government introduced new public transport, such as metro and bus systems. They also introduced dedicated bus lanes and traffic lights in high congestion zones.

hint.text: Congestion is when there are so many cars on the road that it is hard for them to move easily, meaning they are releasing more carbon emissions while moving slowly on the road.
hint.label: Congestion

atoms.text: The New Delhi government then also switched all public fuel sources to Compressed Natural Gas. CNG produces a lot fewer emissions than diesel and petrol. It is also cheaper for the city of New Delhi, as it can be produced in India rather than imported from somewhere else.

atoms.a: What did the government introduce to help reduce air pollution caused by congestion?

instruction.text: How do you think New Delhi has benefitted from these measures? Select all correct answers.
